beats.text: Who's kinkier, men or women? Brace yourself.
Researchers asked over a thousand adults about unusual sexual interests.
Almost half had at least one. And a third had actually tried one.
Fetishes? Women reported a bit more than men. Pain and submission? Women too. Twenty-eight percent versus nineteen.
Men led in other areas. But the gap was far smaller than the stereotype.
So the kinky one in your relationship might not be who you think.

sources: Joyal & Carpentier (2017). The prevalence of paraphilic interests and behaviors in the general population. Journal of Sex Research 54(2). 1,040 adults (Quebec); 45.6% desire for at least one paraphilic behavior, 33.9% experience; fetishism desire women 47.9% vs men 40.4% (n.s.); masochism desire women 27.8% vs men 19.2%; men higher in voyeurism/frotteurism; sample not fully probabilistic. Via paper PDF + Sex & Psychology.
